resolved.title: 列表操作
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

To check if an item is in a particular list, we can use the [b]in[/b] operator. 

It returns [b]True [/b]if the item occurs one or more times in the list, and [b]False [/b]if it doesn't. Like this:[code format="py" codeId="3920"]words = ["spam", "egg", "spam", "sausage"]
print("spam" [b]in [/b]words)
print("egg" [b]in [/b]words)
print("tomato" [b]in [/b]words)[/code]
[note]The [b]in [/b]operator is also used to determine whether or not a string is a substring of another string.[/note]

要检查一个项目是否在一个特定的列表中，我们可以使用in操作符。

resolved.problem_statement_md:
假设你正在制作一个语音识别系统。所有支持的命令被储存如下列表里：

```text
["Lights Off", "Lock the door", "Open the door", "Make Coffee", "Shut down"]
```

请写一个程序，判断给出的命令是否在列表中。
如果在，输出"OK"，如果不在输出 "No"。

The supported commands are stored in a list.

Complete the program to take a command as input, check if it’s supported and output "OK", if it is, and "Not supported", if not.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
Lights Off

[b]Sample Output[/b]
OK 

[note]The given code declares the list of supported commands.[/note]
